liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): Reviewer says the show only gets going with Estimated Prophet into Eyes of the World, after an ordinary first set; Estimated Prophet is called excellent by this reviewer [21][24]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): First set includes a very nice Franklin's Tower [24]
- **Olin Arageed** (1 review): Reviewer downloaded this source mainly for this piece, but it is absent from the recording [19]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Not Fade Away into Wharf Rat into Around and Around is called extremely hot [21]
- **Johnny B. Goode** (1 review): Reviewer picks Johnny B. Goode as the best part of the show [26]

## Setlist highlights

- **Olin Arageed**: rare: 14 archived performances [29]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-08-05.mtx.menke.motb-0100.98716.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 200 min; rated 4.43/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience portion of the matrix gives the bass guitar more presence than the soundboard does; Matrix mix is well balanced and carefully made, with fuller bass than the soundboard [26][27]
- **gd1979-08-05.158644.sbd.gems.flac2496**: soundboard; 23 songs; 191 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1979-08-05.179201.sbd.miller.t.flac1648**: soundboard; 23 songs; 190 min [4]
- **gd1979-08-05.179200.sbd.miller.fixed.flac2496**: soundboard; 23 songs; 190 min [5]
- **gd1979-08-05.179189.sbd.miller.t.flac1648**: soundboard; 23 songs; 190 min [6]
- **gd79-08-05.sbd.munder.9579.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 177 min; rated 4/5 by 11 [16]. Said about its sound: Recording has technical glitches and missing parts, including Olin Arageed; Althea is abruptly cut off at its end in this recording; Several songs have cuts, and Olin Arageed is entirely missing; Brent's electric piano tone is slightly distracting [21][22][24]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended both this show and the previous night's, and says the recordings bring back memories [18]
- Reviewer felt Jerry was clearly in strong form this night [25]
- Reviewer was present at the concert [26]
- Hamza el-Din played percussion and sang on Olin Arageed [2]
- Hamza el-Din joined the band on Olin Arageed [4]
- Hamza el-Din performed with the band on Olin Arageed [5]
- Hamza el-Din appears on Olin Arageed [6]
- This recording and the previous night's are improvements over versions that circulated among traders for years [18]
- Reviewer says 1979 Altheas are generally hot, which makes the cut here more regrettable [22]
- Reviewer prefers this show to some Dick's Picks releases [25]
- Reviewer counts it as another very solid 1979 show in matrix and soundboard quality [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-08-05.mtx.menke.motb-0100.98716.flac16**: taped by Bob Menke; transferred by Bob Menke and Derek McCabe; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [1]
- **gd1979-08-05.158644.sbd.gems.flac2496**: taped by Recorded by Augustus Owsley Stanley III (aka Bear); transferred by Transferred (July 2022) and mastered by Jim Blackwood Speed/pitch adjusted by Jason Chastain Minor repairs, track, FLAC, and pack by Steve Gravel; source: Set 1 and Scarlet Begonias: Bear-sourced cassette. Nakamichi CR-7A > Tascam DA-3000 @ 24 bit 96 kHz Set 2 starting at Fire on the Mountain: Anon sourced file… [2]. Also: Mono video soundboard source, upsampled to 96kHz to match the Bear source, patches several songs including Althea and Good Lovin'; Bob Menke audience recording supplies patches in Wharf Rat and Johnny B. Goode; the set aired on KXCI Tucson in 2022 [2]
- **gd1979-08-05.179201.sbd.miller.t.flac1648**: transferred by Mastered by Charlie Miller  August 8, 2026; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Maxell UDXL-II) [4]. Also: Dolby decoding fine-tuned with DDi Codec; Good Lovin' fixed; this is a 16-bit downconversion of the 24-bit version; Johnny B. Goode is patched from a Bob Menke recording, with patch source credited to Jim Blackwood [4]
- **gd1979-08-05.179200.sbd.miller.fixed.flac2496**: transferred by Mastered by Charlie Miller  August 8, 2026; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Maxell UDXL-II) [5]. Also: Fix of an earlier transfer, correcting Good Lovin', with Dolby decoding fine-tuned using DDi Codec and pitch correction applied; Johnny B. Goode patch comes from a Bob Menke recording [5]
- **gd1979-08-05.179189.sbd.miller.t.flac1648**: transferred by Mastered by Charlie Miller  August 8, 2026; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Maxell UDXL-II) [6]. Also: Dolby decoding fine-tuned with DDi Codec; pitch correction applied; this is a 16-bit tagged version of the 24-bit transfer; Johnny B. Goode is patched from a Bob Menke recording, with Jim Blackwood providing the patch source [6]
- **gd79-08-05.sbd.munder.9579.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [16]
